Record Class GameStats

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
maybe_c.happy.api.data.GameStats
Record Components:
playerId - 玩家
gameId - 小游戏 ID
plays - 打过几局
wins - 赢了几局
losses - 输了几局
kills - 击杀
deaths - 死亡
score - 自定义积分。各游戏含义自定，排行榜默认按它排
playtimeMs - 累计游玩时长（毫秒）
lastPlayed - 最后一次游玩的毫秒时间戳
public record GameStats(@NotNull UUID playerId, @NotNull String gameId, int plays, int wins, int losses, int kills, int deaths, long score, long playtimeMs, long lastPlayed) extends Record
一个玩家在一个小游戏上的累计战绩。

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
